description: For the order's wallet: the unsigned StandingOrders.cancel(agentId) transaction. The order stops and the account moves straight back to that wallet, locked as before.

agentId.description: The ERC-8004 agentId on Robinhood Chain, as a decimal string or integer.

wallet.description: The wallet of the account's standing order.
